summary: This table presents an overview of client metrics for the quarters ending December 31, 2025, September 30, 2025, and December 31, 2024. It includes the number of active clients, clients added during the period, and various categories of million-dollar clients. Notably, the number of active clients increased from 1,876 in December 2024 to 1,949 in December 2025. The table also details client contributions to revenues, showing a slight decrease in the percentage from the top 5 and top 10 clients over the observed periods. Additionally, the Days Sales Outstanding remained consistent at 41 days across the last two periods.
